title: Myth: leopards need deep forest

scenes.headline: Leopards only live in deep forest.
Some live among farms and villages.
scenes.body: In Akole, Maharashtra, camera traps found leopards in cropland with 300+ people per km².

scenes.label: adult leopards per 100 km² of that farmland
scenes.body: Striped hyenas lived there too, at a similar density.

scenes.headline: And attacks on people there were rare.
scenes.body: Big cats and dense human populations can share space.

caption:
Leopards can live in farmland next to millions of people.

Globally, leopards are listed as Vulnerable and now occur in only about 25% of their historical range.

Sources: Athreya V. et al. (2013) Big cats in our backyards, PLOS ONE 8:e57872; IUCN Red List (Stein et al. 2016). Footage: Rajaji TR, India and Kruger NP. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Busts a belief with an Indian field study and a precise density, ending on coexistence rather than fear; strong fit for school audiences near cities.
